summary: Learn culture diagnostics, stakeholder mapping, and adoption scorecards in 5 days. Build practical change tools for real transformation.
lede: Cultural change training helps professionals assess workplace culture and plan interventions that support adoption of new ways of working. It covers culture diagnostics using the Burke-Litwin Model and McKinsey 7S Framework, stakeholder and readiness analysis, resistance planning, and adoption tracking with scorecards and dashboards. It is for change, HR, organizational development, transformation, and internal communications professionals who need to guide behavior shifts and report progress.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to diagnose culture, guide adoption, and report transformation progress with credible tools.
prerequisites: To get the most from this course, you should have working experience in HR, organizational development, transformation, change delivery, or business operations. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable reading organizational data, participating in group exercises, and working with templates such as culture assessments, stakeholder matrices, communication plans, and adoption scorecards. Familiarity with change initiatives, employee engagement, or transformation programs will help you apply the tools faster.
